memory: I have confirmed biexponential adsorption and measured H2O τ_fast: 64±6, 100±9, 160±11, 255±18 s (25→10°C). New direct D2O τ_fast: 88±7 (25°C), 136±10 (20°C), 215±16 (15°C), 345±24 (10°C). The isotope difference is a roughly constant multiplicative offset (≈1.37), suggesting a change in pre-exponential factor rather than Ea. Mechanistic origin remains open.
